name: print-social-mega-sale-50-off-banner-black-orange-zigzag-glow
title: 'Mega Sale 50% Off' banner with jagged orange zigzag corners and a glowing tilted price tag
whatItIs: A black square banner with jagged orange zigzag shapes cutting the top-left and bottom-right corners, bold white 'MEGA SALE' with a glowing orange outline, a tilted orange '50% OFF' price-tag ribbon, and small dashed line accents.
whatItMeans: Loud and urgent; jagged zigzag edges and a glow effect give a simple discount banner maximum shelf-stopping energy.
techniques: Cut banner corners with jagged zigzag shapes for energy.
Glow the headline's outline for a hot, urgent feel.
Tilt the price callout for dynamic emphasis.

vocabulary.definition: A jagged angular shape used to break a banner's edge.
A soft light effect applied to a shape's edge or stroke.
